worldcombat.skill.reflect.summary: Raise a ring of hard-light plates around yourself and nearby allies; physical damage taken is cut, and the mirror form knocks part of a blocked melee blow back at the attacker. The wall follows the caster, and anyone who leaves its reach loses the cover.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.use.1: Bounce part of a melee rush back
worldcombat.skill.reflect.use.2: Raise the wall before the foe's physical push
worldcombat.skill.reflect.description.0: The plates cover the caster and allies within %2$s blocks for %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.description.1: Physical damage taken is cut by %1$s; in the mirror form, part of a blocked melee blow (%2$s) is knocked back at the attacker.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.description.2: The wall is built from about %1$s hard-light plates and moves with the caster.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.description.3: Raising it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the form note for the mirror/bastion trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.form.0: Mirror: cut x0.8, melee rebound on (part of the blocked damage returns to the attacker, heavier with higher Attack), -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown - a bit less mitigation for a counter and a faster raise.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.form.1: Bastion: cut x1.18, no rebound, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.12 cooldown - thicker cover at a slower raise and longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.reflect.preference.mir: Mirror: cut x0.8, part of a blocked melee blow returns to the attacker, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown. Bastion: cut x1.18, no rebound, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.12 cooldown.
The partner only considers the wall while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise it on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the wall.
